matrix_interpretation: The 1,365 rows enumerate 65 configured country choices x 21 published global locale choices. They are not 1,365 recommended campaigns, native selectable target combinations, native-language certification, shipping destinations, or paid activation. There is no automatic language-to-country assignment; each row references the exact candidate dress URL and existing campaign if present.
shopify_market_notes: All six market webPresences and the global webPresence markets connections are empty; schema documents fallback to primary domain country selectors.
AU, CA and GB each occur in two market conditions. Precedence was not queried; no duplicate-market defect or pruning is inferred.
Country currency settings are metadata, not checkout price/currency. Norway reports EUR.
BR, IN, JP, KR and IL are absent from returned country conditions despite related published locales.

microsoft_source_notes.correction_to_early_finding: Hindi is expressly in current help Available ad languages; early inference from older Ad Languages guide that Hindi was unsupported is superseded. Korean remains absent from both ad lists and present under interface/display languages.
microsoft_source_notes.language_codes: Shopify no maps to Microsoft Norwegian/NB. pt-BR maps to Portuguese/PT and storefront /pt/. Hindi code not asserted because current API guide does not document it.
microsoft_source_notes.country_source_limit: Current linked market-availability help returned Oops and its linked official repository Countries.md returned404. Latest exact geo data requires an authenticated Microsoft API/developer route owned by root; this lane did not access it. The January2023 market list is historical evidence only. Country names in Product Language or Country Codes tables are not ad-serving eligibility. The corresponding Learn Countries path also failed with a non-retryable tool error; no further retrieval attempted.
microsoft_source_notes.country_current_account_validation: Only US/en and DE/de have exact saved country/language targets in the dated root receipt inspected here; account browser not reopened by reviewer.

public_read_limitations: Plain unauthenticated GET/source inspection, no browser rendering, language/country POST, cart, consent or checkout action.
Nine successful pages then twelve429 responses in the same bounded concurrent batch. No storefront retry or alternate-path bypass followed.
English selector exposes65 country values; all21 Admin dress routes occur in its hreflang links. The12 rate-limited individual routes remain candidates.
Source snapshots can contain auxiliary Shipping Policy headings in English; title/html-lang/product-link checks do not certify full native-language translation or policy quality.
Each successful first-page source contained36 distinct product paths; this is a page-link count, not proof of total stock, supplier availability or all37 collection offers.
unresolved_launch_dependencies: Current exact Microsoft country/language eligibility; especially four help/API conflicts, five account-availability languages and historical market omissions.
Twelve rate-limited localized page source reads plus country-selected desktop/mobile buyer rendering for every eventual target.
Actual applicable shipping zone/rates, supplier delivery and delivered costs, selected product availability and truthful localized offer copy.
Current purchase/consent/value/dedup receiver evidence and root-owned economics/cash/spend controls.
Root review of nine reserve dress-route replacements; no campaign CSV or platform route changed by this inventory.
